seoTitle: How to Link Asana and Outlook Easily
metaDescription: Learn how to install the Asana for Outlook add-in in 2026 so you can convert emails into tasks and assign due dates without leaving your inbox.
intro: The Asana for Outlook add-in turns your inbox into a task creation tool, letting you convert emails into trackable work without switching apps. This guide covers installing the add-in from the Outlook store, authenticating your Asana account, and converting an email into a task with a due date and project.

steps.heading: Open the Outlook Add-ins store
steps.body: Navigate your Outlook inbox and open the Microsoft Add-ins store panel.

steps.heading: Install the Asana add-in
steps.body: Search for the official Asana for Outlook integration and click Install.

steps.heading: Launch the add-in on an email
steps.body: Open an email and launch the Asana add-in panel from within that message.

steps.heading: Authenticate your account
steps.body: Securely connect your Asana account credentials through the add-in.

steps.heading: Convert the email into a task
steps.body: Turn the incoming email into a new Asana task, then assign due dates, projects, and teammates directly from Outlook.

faq.question: Does converting an email pre-fill the task description?
faq.answer: Yes, the add-in typically carries over relevant email content to help pre-fill the new task's description.

faq.question: Can I assign the task to a teammate directly from Outlook?
faq.answer: Yes, you can set assignees, due dates, and target projects without leaving the Outlook add-in panel.

faq.question: Is the Asana for Outlook add-in free?
faq.answer: Installing the add-in is free, though task creation and project access still depend on your existing Asana account plan.

faq.question: Will the linked email stay attached to the task?
faq.answer: The add-in is designed to link the email content to the newly created task so context isn't lost.
